insert into cr_title_business_template (title_id, business_template_id, create_time, update_time) values
(#{title_id}, #{business_template_id}, now(), now())
mapper.select: select T1.resource_id as title_id, T3.business_type, T1.score as score, T2.business_template_id, max(T4.score) as user_score, if(T4.score >= T1.score, TRUE, FALSE) as is_finish from cr_title T1 left join cr_title_business_template T2 on T1.resource_id = T2.title_id left join cr_business_template T3 on T2.business_template_id = T3.resource_id left join cr_title_train_progress T4 on T4.business_template_id = T2.business_template_id and T4.user_id = #{user_id} where T1.resource_id in (select title_id from cr_title_business_template where business_template_id = #{business_template_id}) and T1.resource_id not in (select title_id from cr_title_user where user_id = #{user_id}) group by T2.id order by T4.create_time
